title: ATX credential (wire form, versions 1.0 and 1.1)
description: Structural schema for the ATX credential as it appears on the wire, derived from atx-spec core.md sections 1.1, 1.3a, and 1.5 with the atx-conformance fixture set as ground truth. Validates shape only: signature verification, canonical-form byte rules (section 1.3a), and revocation state are verifier concerns a schema cannot express.

id.description: Issuance identifier. Excluded from the to-be-signed projection (section 1.3a.2).

atcVersion.description: Wire name of the version field (section 1.1). Selects the canonical signing form: 1.0 legacy eleven-field string (section 1.3a.1), 1.1 JCS-canonicalized TBS object (section 1.3a.2). The registered version set is governed by section 14.

publisherDid.description: The empty string when unknown (section 1.3a.2 rule 1).

version.description: Version of the agent artifact the credential attests, not of ATX itself.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the agent content, lowercase hex without a prefix (fixture-pinned wire form).

buildAttestation.description: Build attestation reference; production issuance emits a provenance URI. The empty string when unknown (section 1.3a.2 rule 1).

transparencyLogIndex.description: Optional. The RFC 6962 index the issuer's transparency log assigned to this credential's issuance entry (section 6); set after signing and excluded from the TBS (section 1.3a.2), so it is a lookup key for the inclusion proof, never evidence of inclusion. Omitting it does not exempt the issuance from being logged before it takes effect (section 11 commitment 3, section 12).

oneOf.description: JSON null: treated as absent (section 1.3a.2 rule 5) - tolerated on the wire, omitted from the TBS.
Empty object: treated as absent (section 1.3a.2 rule 5) - tolerated on the wire, omitted from the TBS.

observationDays.description: At most 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1), the range in which an implementation that reads a JSON number as an IEEE 754 double and one that keeps the exact integer hold the same value (section 1.3a.2 rule 3).

behavioralProfile.description: JSON null is treated as absent (section 1.3a.2 rule 1) - tolerated on the wire, and projected into the TBS as JSON null, as an omitted behavioralProfile is. Any other value is present and must be an object of exactly these three members.

scanSummary.description: All six required members must be present, zero-valued where unknown (section 1.3a.2 rule 2). The optional techniques member is presence-based (section 1.3a.2 rule 6).

criticalFindings.description: At most 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1), the range in which an implementation that reads a JSON number as an IEEE 754 double and one that keeps the exact integer hold the same value (section 1.3a.2 rule 3).

highFindings.description: At most 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1), the range in which an implementation that reads a JSON number as an IEEE 754 double and one that keeps the exact integer hold the same value (section 1.3a.2 rule 3).

techniques.description: Optional. Threat Matrix technique IDs (T-NNNN, section 11 commitment 2) that the summarized scan results reference, each listed at most once. Signed under 1.1 when present, in wire order; an empty array or JSON null is treated as absent - tolerated on the wire, omitted from the TBS (section 1.3a.2 rule 6).

trustScore.description: 0-100 scale JSON number on the wire; string-encoded %.6f only inside the v1.1 TBS projection (section 1.3a.2 rule 3).

signatures.description: Under atcVersion 1.1 the array carries at least one Ed25519 and one ML-DSA-65 entry (section 1.1); see the allOf rule at the root.

allOf.description: Hybrid signature block (section 1.1): an ATX 1.1 credential carries at least one Ed25519 and one ML-DSA-65 signature entry. signatures is outside the signed bytes (section 1.3a.2), so deleting one suite's entry leaves the other entry's signature valid; this rule refuses the result. atcVersion 1.0 is frozen legacy and is not constrained here. atx-conformance fixtures that declare atcVersion 1.1 and carry Ed25519 only, or ML-DSA-65 only, fail this rule (core.md section 12).

capability.description: namespace:action capability token in the AIP section 4.1 grammar: a reserved namespace, or a namespace prefixed with the defining organization's domain and a slash; there is no wildcard action.

declaredPurpose.description: Optional ATX 1.1 field (section 1.5). Identity and attestation property, never an authorization input.

anyOf.description: org.name custom category (section 1.5.3): defaults to the broadest, most sensitive class until reviewed.

capabilityJustification.description: Map of each granted capability to the taskScope tokens it serves (section 1.5.2). Keys must be a subset of capabilities: this schema checks each key against the capability grammar, but the subset relation is a cross-field rule it cannot express.
